The user asks: "What are the names of proteins found in the plasma membrane?" They want a list of proteins found in the plasma membrane. We can provide a general answer: e.g., integral membrane proteins like receptors (GPCRs, ion channels), transporters, adhesion molecules, etc. But we might also use the function cellbio_get_proteins to get a list of proteins in a specific cell compartment. The user didn't specify a particular cell compartment, but they asked about plasma membrane. So we can call the function with cell_compartment="plasma membrane". The function signature: cellbio_get_proteins({cell_compartment: string, include_description?: boolean}). We can set include_description to false or true. The user didn't ask for descriptions, just names. So we can set include_description to false. Then we can return the list.
